params.expression:
JSON.stringify({
  url: location.href,
  title: document.title,
  txt: (document.body.innerText||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,500),
  visBtns: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(b=>b.offsetParent!==null).map(b=>(b.innerText||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,12),
  inputs: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input')).filter(i=>i.offsetParent!==null).map(i=>({id:i.id,t:i.type,v:(i.value||'').slice(0,30)})).slice(0,8)
})
